<style>
.msg-root{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,380px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}
.msg-panel{padding:14px;border:1px solid #d9ddd8;border-radius:12px;background:#fffdfa}
.msg-panel h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:14px}
.msg-controls{display:grid;gap:8px}
.msg-controls label{display:grid;gap:4px;font-size:8px;font-weight:750}
.msg-controls select,.msg-controls input{width:100%;min-height:36px}
.msg-template-list{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}
.msg-template{display:grid;gap:3px;width:100%;padding:9px;border:1px solid #dde2dd;border-radius:9px;text-align:left;background:#fff}
.msg-template.active,.msg-template:hover{border-color:#9bc8c5;background:#eef6f4}
.msg-template strong{font-size:9px}.msg-template small{font-size:7px;color:#72817d}
.msg-preview{display:grid;gap:10px}
.msg-preview-box{min-height:180px;padding:16px;border:1px solid #d9ddd8;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;line-height:1.55;font-size:10px}
.msg-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.msg-placeholders{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.msg-placeholder{padding:4px 6px;border-radius:999px;background:#e8f0ee;color:#43625f;font:700 7px/1.1 monospace}
.msg-modal{width:min(720px,94vw);border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:16px}
.msg-form{display:grid;gap:10px}.msg-form label{display:grid;gap:4px;font-size:8px}
.msg-form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
@media(max-width:850px){.msg-root{grid-template-columns:1fr}.msg-form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
script:
<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.MENSAGENS=async ctx=>{
 const {el,button,call,status,richEditor}=App;
 const root=ctx.root;
 let data={modelos:[],podeEditar:false};
 let selected=null;
 let people=[];
 const left=el('div',undefined,'msg-panel');
 const right=el('div',undefined,'msg-panel msg-preview');
 root.append(left,right);

 const h=el('div',undefined,'agenda-toolbar');
 const title=el('h3','Biblioteca institucional');
 const add=button('+ Nova mensagem',()=>editTemplate(),true);
 h.append(title,add);
 const controls=el('div',undefined,'msg-controls');
 const personSel=el('select');
 personSel.append(new Option('Sem cadastro vinculado',''));
 const search=el('input');search.type='search';search.placeholder='Filtrar modelos';
 const field=(label,node)=>{const w=el('label');w.append(el('span',label),node);return w;};
 controls.append(field('Assistido',personSel),field('Buscar modelo',search));
 const list=el('div',undefined,'msg-template-list');
 left.append(h,controls,list);

 const previewTitle=el('h3','Selecione uma mensagem');
 const previewMeta=el('p','Use os modelos para manter o padrão institucional independentemente de quem estiver atendendo.','hint');
 const previewBox=el('div','', 'msg-preview-box');
 const actions=el('div',undefined,'msg-actions');
 const placeholders=el('div',undefined,'msg-placeholders');
 right.append(previewTitle,previewMeta,placeholders,previewBox,actions);

 const PLACE=['<<NOME>>','<<CPF>>','<<TELEFONE>>','<<EMAIL>>','<<MUNICIPIO>>','<<JURISDICAO>>','<<ENTIDADE>>','<<PROCESSO>>','<<RESPONSAVEL>>'];
 PLACE.forEach(p=>placeholders.append(el('span',p,'msg-placeholder')));

 function renderList(){
   list.replaceChildren();
   const q=search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
   const models=(data.modelos||[]).filter(m=>!q||[m.titulo,m.categoria,m.conteudo].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q));
   if(!models.length)list.append(el('p','Nenhum modelo encontrado.','hint'));
   models.forEach(m=>{
     const b=el('button',undefined,'msg-template'+(selected?.id===m.id?' active':''));
     b.type='button';b.append(el('strong',m.titulo),el('small',(m.categoria||'GERAL')+' · '+(m.canal||'WHATSAPP')));
     b.onclick=()=>selectModel(m);list.append(b);
   });
   add.hidden=!data.podeEditar;
 }

 async function selectModel(m){
   selected=m;renderList();await renderPreview();
 }

 async function renderPreview(){
   actions.replaceChildren();
   if(!selected){previewTitle.textContent='Selecione uma mensagem';previewBox.innerHTML='';return;}
   previewTitle.textContent=selected.titulo;
   const personId=personSel.value;
   const rendered=await call('mensagemModeloRenderizar',{id:selected.id,pessoaId:personId},false,{noLoader:true});
   if(!App.alive(ctx)||selected.id!==rendered.id)return;
   previewBox.innerHTML=rendered.html||'';
   previewMeta.textContent=personId?'Prévia preenchida com os dados do cadastro selecionado.':'Prévia sem cadastro: placeholders dependentes da pessoa ficam vazios.';
   const copy=button('Copiar mensagem',async()=>{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(rendered.texto||'');status('Mensagem copiada.');},true);
   const whats=button('Abrir no WhatsApp',()=>{
     const phone=String(rendered.telefone||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
     if(!phone){status('O cadastro selecionado não possui telefone.',true);return;}
     const national=phone.startsWith('55')?phone:'55'+phone;
     window.open('https://wa.me/'+national+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(rendered.texto||''),'_blank','noopener,noreferrer');
   },false);
   actions.append(copy,whats);
   if(data.podeEditar){
     actions.append(button('Editar modelo',()=>editTemplate(selected),true),button('Inativar',async()=>{if(!confirm('Inativar este modelo?'))return;await call('mensagemModeloExcluir',{id:selected.id},true);selected=null;await loadModels();},true));
   }
 }

 function editTemplate(model){
   const dialog=el('dialog',undefined,'msg-modal');
   const form=el('form',undefined,'msg-form');
   const heading=el('h3',model?'Editar mensagem padrão':'Nova mensagem padrão');
   const grid=el('div',undefined,'msg-form-grid');
   const field=(label,node)=>{const w=el('label');w.append(el('span',label),node);return w;};
   const name=el('input');name.value=model?.titulo||'';name.required=true;name.maxLength=140;
   const category=el('select');['GERAL','ATENDIMENTO','DOCUMENTOS','PROCESSO','PAGAMENTO','PRAZO','RETORNO'].forEach(v=>category.append(new Option(v,v)));category.value=model?.categoria||'GERAL';
   grid.append(field('Título',name),field('Categoria',category));
   const editor=richEditor(model?.conteudo||'','Texto da mensagem. Use placeholders quando necessário.');
   const ph=el('div',undefined,'msg-placeholders');
   PLACE.forEach(code=>{
     const b=button(code,()=>{editor.focus();document.execCommand('insertText',false,code);},true);b.classList.add('msg-placeholder');ph.append(b);
   });
   const formActions=el('div',undefined,'actions');
   formActions.append(button('Cancelar',()=>dialog.close(),true));
   const save=el('button','Salvar modelo');save.type='submit';formActions.append(save);
   form.append(heading,grid,el('span','Conteúdo','hint'),editor.root,el('span','Inserir placeholder','hint'),ph,formActions);
   form.onsubmit=async ev=>{
     ev.preventDefault();save.disabled=true;
     try{
       await call('mensagemModeloSalvar',{id:model?.id||'',titulo:name.value,categoria:category.value,conteudo:editor.getHtml(),canal:'WHATSAPP',ativo:true,placeholders:PLACE},true);
       dialog.close();await loadModels();
     }finally{save.disabled=false;}
   };
   dialog.append(form);document.body.append(dialog);dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>dialog.remove(),{once:true});dialog.showModal();name.focus();
 }

 async function loadModels(){
   data=await call('mensagensModelos',{},false,{noLoader:true});
   if(!App.alive(ctx))return;
   if(selected)selected=(data.modelos||[]).find(m=>m.id===selected.id)||null;
   renderList();if(selected)await renderPreview();
 }
 search.oninput=renderList;
 personSel.onchange=()=>{if(selected)renderPreview().catch(e=>status(e.message||String(e),true));};

 const requestedPerson=
   App.state.selection&&
   typeof App.state.selection==='object'
     ?String(App.state.selection.pessoaId||'')
     :'';

 if(requestedPerson){
   App.state.selection=null;
 }

 people=await call('pessoasLeve',{limit:5000},false,{noLoader:true}).then(v=>Array.isArray(v)?v:(v.pessoas||v.rows||[])).catch(()=>[]);
 people.forEach(p=>personSel.append(new Option((p.nome||'Sem nome')+' · '+(p.cpf||''),p.id)));
 if(requestedPerson&&people.some(p=>p.id===requestedPerson))personSel.value=requestedPerson;
 await loadModels();
};
</script>
